title: Big Buck Bunny
announcement: Big Buck Bunny. Family comedy, 2008, 10 minutes. 47 descriptions.

cues.text: A vast, pink-hued cloud dominates the sky above a line of green trees, with faint birds visible in the distant, pale upper right.
A stream flows through grass and flowers.
A small purple owl perches on a tree branch.
A mossy, grassy mound with a dark hole at its center, nestled beneath a large tree with exposed roots, surrounded by vibrant green grass and scattered purple flowers.
Bunny stretches contentedly beside a mossy mound with a dark hole.
Bunny lifts its head, eyes closed, toward the bright blue sky.
Bunny’s eyes open slightly as it looks upward, still smiling, beneath a leafy tree branch against a bright blue sky.
Bunny stretches contentedly in a sunlit green field.
Bunny smiles gently, nose near pale blue flowers, eyes half-closed in contentment.
Bunny stands in a sunlit green field, smiling as a purple butterfly hovers near its ear, with distant trees and mountains under a bright blue sky.
A flying squirrel, perched on a tree branch, watches Bunny below, who holds a red apple, surrounded by green grass and leaves.
Bunny turns, waving a paw as a purple butterfly floats nearby.
A red squirrel and a grey chinchilla stand in the grass, the squirrel holding a nut, both looking toward Bunny.
Bunny, a large white rabbit, smiles as a purple butterfly hovers near his head, perched on the tree trunk behind him.
Bunny stands in a grassy field, looking upward with wide eyes.
A flying squirrel, a red squirrel, and a grey chinchilla peer from behind a rock, all laughing with wide eyes.
Bunny stands in a grassy field, surrounded by scattered fruit.
The red squirrel jumps forward, eyes wide and teeth bared.
Bunny stands in a grassy field, hands clasped.
The red squirrel lunges forward, eyes wide.
Bunny stands in a grassy field, arms flung wide, mouth open in a startled gasp as two spiky acorns fall from above.
Bunny leaps through tall grass, then vanishes behind a tree trunk.
Bunny grips a tree trunk with both paws.
Bunny grips a green rope tightly.
Three small animals peek from behind a rock.
A green rope is tied tightly around a tree trunk, with a single leaf attached to its end.
The flying squirrel, red squirrel, and grey chinchilla run along a dirt path through a grassy field.
The red squirrel holds a nut.
The red squirrel holds a nut, the flying squirrel looks up.
A red squirrel with large green eyes and prominent teeth stares forward.
A grey chinchilla sits on a rock, holding a nut, its fur dark and ears perked.
A dark shape streaks across the sky above the forest canopy.
A flying squirrel with wide, startled eyes and a brown-and-white body stands on rocks near a tree trunk, its tail twitching.
A red squirrel perches on a tree branch, eyes narrowed and tail upright, surveying the scene below.
The flying squirrel spreads its arms wide on a tree branch.
The flying squirrel glides through the sky.
A red squirrel balances on a branch, eyes narrowed, watching a peach hang nearby as leaves rustle in the breeze.
Leaves swirl in the sunlit forest clearing.
A large white rabbit stands on a dirt path.
A flying squirrel glides through the air.
Sharp pencil points stand upright in a row, facing forward, against a sunlit forest backdrop.
A red squirrel perches on a branch, eyes wide, as the large white rabbit approaches.
The large white rabbit smiles broadly, its brown eyes fixed forward with a knowing expression.
The red squirrel’s eyes widen in fear.
The large white rabbit stands in a grassy field, holding a string to a flying squirrel kite.
On screen: Peach Open Movie Team.
The red squirrel, eyes wide with fear, flies overhead as the flying squirrel glides through the sky, its arms spread wide on the kite.
